column3: MT 3:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; יְשׁוּעָתָה (“salvation”) is rendered “help.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיַּעֲנֵנִי (“he answered me”) is rendered “He heard me,” and “mountain of holiness” “holy hill.”
Close to the Hebrew; לֶחִי (“jaw, cheek”) is rendered “on the cheekbone,” and “the wicked” “the ungodly.”
